plan.task: Exact interval feasibility of a single hard-path peak under a small-soft component cap and monotone RESET u
plan.original_reset_mask: finite absI>=1e-12 A and nonzero voltage; retain original2799 points in native acquisition order
plan.raw_band_scope: Deterministic sensitivity allowances, not measured noise or replacement scoring gates
plan.Gamma_cap_source: Maximum Gamma of saved refined linear-field seriescycle4 SET trajectory, with its exact frozen gc
plan.Gamma_cap_scope: Predeclared small-soft component hypothesis only, not measured or required bare-device state bound; no tuning after results
plan.numerical_allowance_scope: Fixed inherited numerical sensitivity on soft-current cap, not extra raw-current noise or a global numerical certificate
plan.a_interval_s: L=max(0,((1-delta)*absI-Bcap)/v), U=(1+delta)*absI/v; no subtraction of background as an observed equality
plan.single_peak_necessity: Nonincreasing equilibrium makes a either monotone or first increase then decrease, with platforms allowed. All peak indices including endpoints are permitted
plan.exact_interval_test: For every candidate peak p, prefix admits a nondecreasing sequence and suffix admits a nonincreasing sequence. Use cumulative maxima of L and cumulative feasibility against U; no physical fit or rate selection
plan.witness_rule: If infeasible, find i<j<k with L_i>U_j and L_k>U_j. Rank witnesses by min(L_i,L_k)/U_j, ties by earliest middle native index. Also report maximum absolute gap
plan.high_signal_scope: All three raw currents must exceed10uA for strong classification. Lower-current witnesses retained and downgraded, never deleted from original mask
plan.synthetic_control: Independently enumerate all216 three-node intervals with integer endpoints from0,1,2 and compare interval decision to all integer sequences; include a few longer named monotone/peak/valley/overlap cases
plan.failure_policy: Preserve failed outputs; no cap tuning, looser current bands, new records, or automatic rerun
plan.interpretation: Failure excludes only this monotone-u, bounded-soft, shared-direction-envelope birth/death structure. Passing is an optimistic necessary relaxation with independent per-node interval choices, not proof of a common u trajectory or shared rates

interpretation: Gamma_cap is a predeclared bounded-soft hypothesis, not an empirical bound on the bare device.
The cap may vary freely per point from0 toBcap in this necessary relaxation; no equality subtraction or measured state decomposition is assumed.
Every peak position and every interval choice is allowed. Failure therefore cannot be fixed by choosing different common rate constants inside this component class.
Passing does not supply a shared u trajectory, shared rates, SET formation, cross-topology transfer, or complete unified-model accuracy.

Failure excludes only monotone RESET u, this shared-direction-envelope birth/death structure, and the bounded-soft cap together. It excludes no arbitrary bidirectional channel, stochastic model, contact readout, or wider soft-state scenario.
Raw20% bands and the fixed0.3% numerical soft upper allowance are sensitivity assumptions, not calibrated noise.
All original2799 scoring points retained.10uA is evidence grading for three-node witnesses, not a new score mask.
No measured time clock is introduced; native ordering is used, including duplicate apex samples as a permissive state relaxation.
